_doc: Motion-comic furniture spec for 'Father, forgive them'. Beats are on the TRUE per-turn audio timeline (probed from _turns/__atempo files, sums to 57.15s — NOT the scrambled meta). Each beat = one inked clip (tpl full) + a caption or a red Scripture/red-letter bar. Captions are condensed narration; the two red bars are the ONLY highlighted holy text (Jesus' prayer + the KJV cast-lots quote). Motion 'static' => engine boomerang-fills a hold; other motions => slow-forward fill (no reverse).

cap.text: Soldiers at his feet, gambling for his clothes.
It is a prayer - for the very people killing him.
Father, forgive them; for they know not what they do.
cap.speaker: JESUS

cap.text: Luke records it as they gambled:
And they parted his raiment, and cast lots.
cap.speaker: SCRIPTURE

cap.text: It does not excuse the sin. It intercedes for the sinner.
The sin that put him there was ours too.
He still lives to intercede for sinners.
While we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
Come, and receive it by faith.
